explanation: The statement concerns the library's own definition `vertexPreReflectionList l = (l.reverse.map (vertexPreReflection Q)).prod`. It says that repeating a word N times raises its product to the N-th power. Mathlib has the generic list-product lemmas `List.prod_flatten`, `List.prod_replicate` and `List.map_flatten`. Getting from them to this statement would also need `List.reverse_flatten`, `List.reverse_replicate`, `List.map_replicate` and a rewrite of the product. That is more than one or two short lines, so I did not count it as a special case. I found no Mathlib declaration that states the result directly. The existing proof is an induction using the library's own `vertexPreReflectionList_append`.
